title: DoubleTree by Hilton to Debut in Parramatta as Hilton Expands Greater Sydney Pipeline
summary: Hilton announced the signing of DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta, a 100‑room hotel set to open in late 2028 in New South Wales, Australia.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


New signing will introduce DoubleTree by Hilton to one of Western Sydney’s fastest‑growing commercial and infrastructure hubs


- **Hilton has signed DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta, a 100-room hotel slated to open in late 2028 at 34 Hassall Street in Parramatta.**
- **The hotel will form part of a mixed-use development by Deicorp Group and will be operated by Trilogy Hotels.**
- **The signing introduces Hilton to Parramatta and strengthens the company’s Greater Sydney pipeline in one of Western Sydney’s fastest-growing commercial and infrastructure hubs.**


**SYDNEY -**[Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/corporate/) (NYSE: HLT) today announced the signing of DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta, a 100-room hotel set to open in late 2028 at 34 Hassall Street in Parramatta, New South Wales, Australia. The signing will introduce Hilton to the Parramatta market and bring[DoubleTree by Hilton](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/doubletree-by-hilton/?msockid=2387114ed6566c08320d0434d7116d14) ’s signature warm welcome to one of Greater Sydney’s fastest-growing commercial centres.


Developed under a franchise agreement with Deicorp Group and operated by Trilogy Hotels, the hotel will be part of a mixed-use development that includes hotel, residential, commercial and retail components. Located adjacent to the Robin Thomas light rail stop, the property will offer convenient access to Parramatta Railway Station, Parramatta Wharf, Parramatta Square, Westmead Health Precinct and Western Sydney University.


DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta - Aerial Rendering


Parramatta’s strong population growth, major public transportation investment and diversified demand across corporate, government, education, health and leisure travel make it a compelling market for DoubleTree by Hilton and an important addition to Hilton’s Greater Sydney pipeline.


“The signing of DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta reflects Hilton’s continued growth momentum in Australasia and our strategy to expand in high-demand urban markets where we see long-term opportunity,” said Tushar Raniga, director of development, Hilton Australasia. “With Parramatta emerging as Sydney’s second central business district, supported by major infrastructure investment and a diverse demand base, this is a strong fit for DoubleTree by Hilton. We are pleased to build a new relationship with Deicorp Group and continue our partnership with Trilogy Hotels as we strengthen Hilton’s presence in Greater Sydney.”


DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta - Restaurant Rendering


DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta will feature guest rooms ranging from 20 to 45 square metres, an all-day dining restaurant and lounge, 667 square metres of event space, including meeting rooms, a boardroom and pre-function areas, and fitness and wellness facilities designed for today’s business and leisure traveller.


Deicorp founder Fouad Deiri OAM said the hotel reflected the changing nature of Parramatta and the growing demand for quality hospitality in Western Sydney.


“Parramatta has become one of Australia’s most important economic and residential growth regions,” said Deiri. “Bringing DoubleTree by Hilton into Deicorp’s Cosmopolitan project is a natural fit for a location with this depth of corporate and leisure demand. Trilogy Hotels has been an invaluable partner on our other mixed-use hotel projects bringing unmatched regional expertise to this Western Sydney project.”


DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta - Lobby Rendering


Trilogy Hotels CEO Scott Boyes said returning to work alongside Deicorp, and with Hilton as the franchise partner, reflected the kind of long-term partnerships Trilogy is built on.


“Partnership sits at the centre of how we operate and DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta is a project where every party is genuinely invested in the outcome. Deicorp's vision for the precinct, Hilton's brand and distribution strength, and Trilogy's local operating model each play a distinct role, and the whole is stronger for it,” said Boyes.


“Parramatta's transport links, its established commercial core, and the scale of new residential development make this one of the most credible hotel opportunities in Western Sydney. Our commitment to Deicorp and Hilton is to deliver a hotel that performs for owners, resonates with guests, and gives our team a workplace they're proud of.”


Set to open in Q4 2028, DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta will join[Hilton Honors,](https://www.hilton.com/en/hilton-honors/) the award-winning loyalty program with more than 260 million members worldwide. Hilton Honors members who book directly through preferred Hilton channels have access to instant benefits, including flexible points and money payment options, exclusive member discounts and complimentary standard Wi-Fi. Members also enjoy popular digital tools available exclusively through the Hilton Honors mobile app, including digital check-in, room selection and Digital Key.


Read more about DoubleTree by Hilton at[stories.hilton.com/doubletree](https://stories.hilton.com/doubletree) .


##### FAQ: DoubleTree by Hilton to Debut in Parramatta as Hilton Expands Greater Sydney Pipeline


DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta is a 100-room hotel planned for 34 Hassall Street in Parramatta, New South Wales, Australia. The property is slated to open in Q4 2028.


The hotel will operate under DoubleTree by Hilton, a global full-service brand known for its warm welcome, including the signature DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie, contemporary accommodation, food and beverage experiences, fitness offerings and meetings and events spaces. DoubleTree by Hilton spans more than 700 hotels across 63 countries and territories.


DoubleTree by Hilton Parramatta will feature 100 guest rooms ranging from 20 to 45 square metres, an all-day dining restaurant and lounge, 667 square metres of event space, including meeting rooms, a boardroom and pre-function areas, and fitness and wellness facilities.


The signing introduces Hilton to the Parramatta market and supports Hilton’s growth in Greater Sydney. Parramatta’s population growth, major transport investment and diversified demand across corporate, government, education, health and leisure travel make it a compelling market for the brand.


Guests can expect a warm and reliable DoubleTree by Hilton experience in a well-connected mixed-use precinct, with convenient access to Parramatta Railway Station, Parramatta Wharf, Parramatta Square, Westmead Health Precinct and Western Sydney University.

## About Deicorp


Founded in 1999, Deicorp is a privately owned Australian property developer delivering high-quality, transit-oriented residential, commercial and mixed-use projects across Greater Sydney. With a proven track record of creating vibrant communities connected to transport, retail and employment hubs, Deicorp continues to shape the future of Sydney living.

## About Trilogy Hotels


Trilogy Hotels is an independent hotel management company operating across Australia, founded on a commitment to our three key stakeholders: owners, guests, and teams. Trilogy provides owners with an operating platform for investment-grade assets, managed by an experienced local team. Under franchise agreements, global brands may supply branding, distribution, and loyalty programs, while Trilogy delivers the local expertise and focus that drives operational and financial performance. Every hotel is individually assessed and built on a distinct business model designed to maximise returns. As of July 2026, Trilogy's portfolio and pipeline span over 3,900 rooms across 24 hotels. Find out more at[trilogyhotels.com.au](https://www.trilogyhotels.com.au/) .
